The PDB format includes ATOM records with residue name and chain ID. The residues are numbered. We need to count unique residues in chain B. The chain ID is the fifth field in the ATOM line: the column after the atom name? Actually PDB format: columns: 1-6: ATOM, 7-11: serial, 12-16: atom name, 17: altLoc, 18-20: residue name, 21: chain ID, 22-26: residue sequence number, 27: insertion code, etc. In the given data, the chain ID is the character after the residue name?
